ائتكلت (form VIII)
# اِئْتَكَلْتُ (iʔtakaltu) /iʔ.ta.kal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# اِئْتَكَلْتَ (iʔtakalta) /iʔ.ta.kal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# اِئْتَكَلْتِ (iʔtakalti) /iʔ.ta.kal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَكَلَ (iʔtakala)
# اِئْتَكَلَتْ (iʔtakalat) /iʔ.ta.ka.lat/: third-perso
